title: Remove redundant database pre-clean from tests
body:
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 -->

Related to #71577

This PR removes redundant database pre-cleaning from two tests.

- Removes setup-time database cleanup from `TestDotRenderer` while keeping teardown cleanup.
- Removes pre-yield database cleanup from `test_trigger_dag.py` while keeping post-yield cleanup.

The affected tests already clean up their database state after execution, so the pre-cleaning is unnecessary.

Testing:
- `pytest airflow-core/tests/unit/api/common/test_trigger_dag.py airflow-core/tests/unit/utils/test_dot_renderer.py` — 11 passed
- `prek` — all checks passed
